newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-FIORENTINA AND INTER PLAY CUSTOMARY DRAW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FIORENTINA AND INTER PLAY CUSTOMARY DRAW.

text.p: Fiorentina and Internazionale lived up to their record of playing out a draw with a goalless serie A stalemate on Saturday.
Fiorentina, down to 10 men for the last 30 minutes after defender Michele Serena was sent off for a foul on Chilean Ivan Zamorano, squandered at least half a dozen chances in front of goal.

Argentine Gabriel Batitusta, back from a bout of German measles, hit the crossbar in the 64th minute and team mate Stefan Schwarz was no more fortunate three minutes later when his shot brushed a post.

England's Paul Ince, playing against former Manchester United partner Andrei Kanchelskis for the first time in Italy, picked up a second yellow card that will keep him out of Inter's local derby against AC Milan next weekend.
It was the sixth consecutive draw in Florence between Fiorentina and Inter, both pushing to secure a place in Europe next season through their serie A standing if this year's campaigns turn sour.
Inter host Monaco on Tuesday in their UEFA Cup semifinal first leg while Fiorentina are away to Barcelona in the Cupwinners' Cup on Thursday.

The result will bring some satisfaction to Inter's English coach Roy Hodgson who is seeking to keep the team in contention for runners-up slot to Juventus in serie A and Italy's second place in next season's European Cup.
Inter remain third on 42 points, sandwiched between Parma and Sampdoria who meet on Sunday.
Fiorentina, hoping for a berth in the UEFA Cup next season, leap-frogged Atalanta to move ninth on 35.
